why: Settings for run.py that are choices, not code. Change them here.
models_note: Claude lanes only. The Codex lanes (derive_codex, review_codex, check_diagrams) run Codex's configured model. Routing follows os-inputs/_os-model-routing.md: judgment and long drafting on Opus, first-pass classification and alt text on Sonnet, every Claude-written artifact reviewed by Codex.
image_base_note: The public storage URL the diagrams are uploaded to. Read from this environment variable, never written here. Unset means exports are written as PREVIEW files that cannot be mistaken for importable ones.
codex_fallback_note: When Codex is out of usage, the second-family lane runs on Claude with this model, a different model from the Opus author. Results are tagged with the lane, and the gate shows how many were same-family (Orezi, 2026-09-29).
